name: Flat Channel
summary: This EA identifies flat/ranging channel periods in the market and trades breakouts from those channels. It detects consolidation zones using high/low price boundaries over a defined lookback period, then enters trades when price breaks out of the channel, targeting momentum continuation moves.
summary_zh: 该EA识别市场中的横盘/盘整通道区间，并在价格突破通道时进行交易。它通过定义回溯期内的最高价和最低价边界来检测盘整区域，当价格突破通道时入场，目标捕捉动量延续走势。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是通道突破策略，即在市场处于横盘整理阶段时识别出价格通道的上下边界，等待价格突破通道后入场交易。入场条件为价格收盘突破通道上轨时做多，收盘跌破通道下轨时做空。出场条件通常依赖固定止盈止损或通道宽度的倍数来设定目标位。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于通道宽度计算的手数进行交易，未发现明显的马丁格尔或网格特征。资金管理方面，止损通常设置在通道对侧或固定点数，但具体的风控措施取决于参数配置。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于经典的区间突破交易方法，但在震荡市中容易出现假突破导致的连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a channel breakout system that identifies the upper and lower boundaries of a price channel during ranging/consolidation periods, then enters trades when price breaks out of the channel. Entry conditions are: go long when price closes above the upper channel boundary, and go short when price closes below the lower channel boundary. Exit conditions typically rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or multiples of the channel width to set profit targets. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or lots calculated based on the channel width, with no martingale or grid characteristics detected. Money management sets stop-losses at the opposite side of the channel or at a fixed pip distance, though specific risk controls depend on parameter configuration. The overall strategy logic is clear and represents a classic range-breakout trading approach, but it is susceptible to consecutive losses from false breakouts during choppy markets.

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，通道突破是经典且经过验证的交易方法
识别横盘区间后再交易突破，避免了在趋势中追涨杀跌的问题
参数可配置性强，通道周期、止盈止损等均可调整以适应不同市场
pros_en: Clear and simple strategy logic — channel breakout is a classic and well-validated trading method
Trading breakouts only after identifying consolidation avoids chasing trends at wrong levels
Highly configurable parameters allow adaptation of channel period, SL/TP to different market conditions
cons: 横盘通道识别缺乏成交量或波动率确认，容易产生假突破信号
在趋势市场中通道边界会不断扩展，导致突破信号滞后且频繁亏损
缺少对市场状态的过滤机制，无法有效区分趋势市和震荡市
cons_en: Channel identification lacks volume or volatility confirmation, leading to frequent false breakout signals
In trending markets, channel boundaries keep expanding, causing delayed breakout signals and repeated losses
No market regime filter to distinguish between trending and ranging conditions effectively
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率指标来过滤市场状态，仅在确认横盘时才启用通道突破策略
加入成交量确认突破，提高突破信号的可靠性并减少假突破损失
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility indicator to filter market regime — only enable channel breakout when consolidation is confirmed
Incorporate volume confirmation for breakouts to improve signal reliability and reduce losses from false breakouts

risk_points: 假突破在低流动性时段频繁发生，可能导致连续止损
缺少持仓数量检查和重复开仓防护，可能在同一信号上多次开仓
risk_points_en: False breakouts occur frequently during low-liquidity sessions, potentially causing consecutive stop-losses
Lacks position count checks and duplicate entry protection, which may result in multiple entries on the same signal
